title: Daniel Boone Hotel (Charleston, West Virginia)

buildingCutout.basis: The individually confirmed hotel footprint at 405 Capitol Street.

terrainReference.basis: Original sidewalk elevation at the Capitol Street end near the corner with Washington Street.

identities.name: Daniel Boone Hotel (Charleston, West Virginia)
identities.address: 405 Capitol Street, Charleston, West Virginia, USA

mapIdentity.scope: The mapped outline at the National Register address and exact original public-domain Qualla photograph establish the building and exterior proportions.

note: The historic record describes a ten-story blond brick mass, with an ornamented two-story mezzanine base, brick shaft with regularly spaced sash windows and a parapet with terra-cotta balustrade. The early-1980s conversion enclosed the back of the U-shaped plan.
